title: A winding drum driven through an idler
description: Trace the two gear meshes to a keyed drum and predict vertical load travel.
question: Drive A CW in the front view. Find W (vertical travel) at the shown instant.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. External mesh A/I (18/22 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, I negative. External mesh I/B (22/30 teeth) has fixed centers. I negative, B positive. The solid key makes B and D rotate together. B positive, D positive. The taut line follows the right tangent of drum D; CW there is down. D positive, W negative. The requested motion is down (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives rotates. The drum turns about its axle. The suspended load travels on the straight line.

options.label: B
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives stationary. The keyed hub couples the drum to B and the line is taut.

options.label: C
options.explanation: This tuple matches the derived motions. Two external contacts leave the drum clockwise, carrying its right tangent downward.

options.label: D
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives up. This follows a left-side takeoff or misses the second external contact.
